mapper.select: select item_code as code, item_name as name, case when item_or_product = 'PRODUCT' then 'Product' else 'Item' end as type from md_item union all select process_code, process_name, 'Process' from pro_process union all select machinery_code, machinery_name, 'Equipment' from dv_machinery union all select index_code, index_name, 'InspectionItem' from qc_index union all select workorder_code, workorder_name, 'Workorder' from pro_workorder union all select defect_code, defect_name, 'Defect' from qc_defect union all select cast(dept_id as char), dept_name, 'Dept' from sys_dept where del_flag = '0' and status = '0'
mapper.sql: select v.version_id as versionId, d.doc_id as docId, d.library_id as libraryId, d.dept_id as deptId, d.title, task.task_id as taskId from kb_document_version v join kb_document d on d.doc_id = v.doc_id left join kb_ingest_task task on task.version_id = v.version_id and task.stage = 'graph'
mapper.select: where v.active = 1 and v.deleted_at is null and d.deleted_at is null and d.graph_enabled = 1 and (task.task_id is null or task.status = 'pending' or (task.status = 'running' and task.started_at < now() - interval 30 minute) or (task.status = 'failed' and task.finished_at < now() - interval 2 minute)) and v.version_id = #{versionId} order by task.task_id is not null, v.version_id limit 1

where (v.active = 0 or d.graph_enabled = 0 or d.deleted_at is not null) and task.task_id is not null and (task.status != 'running' or task.started_at < now() - interval 30 minute) order by task.task_id limit 1

select v.version_id from kb_document d join kb_document_version v on v.active_doc_id = d.doc_id and v.deleted_at is null join kb_ingest_task task on task.version_id = v.version_id and task.stage = 'graph' and task.status = 'completed' where d.library_id = #{scope.libraryId} and d.dept_id = #{scope.deptId} and d.deleted_at is null and d.graph_enabled = 1
mapper.insert: insert into kb_ingest_task (version_id, stage, status, started_at) values (#{version.versionId}, 'graph', 'running', now())
mapper.update: update kb_ingest_task set status = 'running', started_at = now(), finished_at = null, error = null where task_id = #{taskId} and stage = 'graph'
mapper.delete: delete from kb_ingest_task where task_id = #{taskId} and stage = 'graph'
mapper.update: update kb_ingest_task set status = 'pending', started_at = null, finished_at = null, error = null where version_id = #{versionId} and stage = 'graph' and status = 'failed'
